messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: Users must repeatedly click Open and Save when handling claims, leading to frustration.
  quote: Claims: click "Open"...Claims: click "Save", rage x3
- problem: Saving reports causes repeated rage due to failures.
  quote: Reports: click "Save", rage x3
- problem: The user gets frustrated by having to click Save repeatedly while navigating claim details.
  quote: Claim details: click "Next"...click "Save", rage x3
- problem: The user is frustrated by having to click the Permission button repeatedly.
  quote: Administration: click "Permission", rage x5
Claims: click "Save"
- problem: Saving reports causes repeated rage due to failures.
  quote: Reports: click "Save", rage x3
- problem: The Save action is flaky, forcing users to click multiple times and get angry.
  quote: Claims: click "Details" ... Claims: click "Save", rage x3
- problem: Saving reports causes repeated rage due to failures.
  quote: Reports: click "Save", rage x3
